text: 🇲🇽✊ "Wednesday we'll sign an agreement with producers and distributors to bring down the price of tomatoes." "El miércoles vamos a tener un acuerdo con productores y comercializadores para poder reducir el precio del jitomate." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera 01/06/26 Direct state intervention on prices of basic foods — no "the market will sort itself out." The Secretary of Agriculture, Hacienda, and Profeco brokered the deal with producers and central markets. Causes flagged: a frost in Florida and a tomato plague in Sinaloa.

🇲🇽🎨 "Peña's education reform was punitive: teachers couldn't stay in schools if they didn't pass certain exams. Those evaluations weren't between peers. It was a scheme of punishment, not of improvement." "La Reforma educativa de Peña era punitiva, en un esquema muy punitivo… no era de visión de mejorar sino de castigo." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera 01/06/26 Sheinbaum continues talks with the CNTE teachers' union. Negotiations are ongoing — "some demands cannot be met because of the budget" — but the punitive neoliberal evaluation regime imposed under Peña Nieto is gone.

🇲🇽⚖️ "A legislator cannot stay silent out of fear of losing their visa. When you enter politics, you have to have courage." "No puede ser que un legislador no opine por temor a que le quiten la visa. Hay que tener valentía cuando se entra a la política." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera 01/06/26 Washington has revoked visas of at least 50 Mexican politicians — most of them from Morena. Sheinbaum's response: stop self-censoring. "We have the right to doubt, to question. What's the real reason for revoking a visa?"

🚨🇲🇽 "I don't believe it's President Trump leading this offensive on multiple fronts. I don't believe it. It's sectors of the US far-right that don't want a good relationship between our countries." "No creo que sea el presidente Trump quien ha encabezado esta ofensiva en distintos temas. Son sectores de la ultraderecha de Estados Unidos." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera 01/06/26 Sheinbaum names the actual operators behind the campaign against Mexico — the same far-right networks that fuse with the Mexican opposition that "used to pretend to be center, then moderately right, and now plainly extreme right."

🇲🇽🌎 "Mexico will not be used as a piñata in someone else's electoral dispute. We cooperate — but we do not subordinate ourselves." "México no debe ser usado como piñata en una disputa electoral ajena. Colaboramos, pero no nos subordinamos." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera 01/06/26 Two years to the day after winning the presidency with 35.9 million votes, Sheinbaum drew the line on US interference: cooperation is not subordination.

🇲🇽🔍 "Was the idea Felipe Calderón's — or was it an idea of Barack Obama? Or of the US agencies?" "¿La idea fue de Felipe Calderón o fue una idea de Barack Obama? ¿O de las agencias de Estados Unidos? Porque a lo mejor no era el presidente y eran las agencias." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera 01/06/26 Calderón launched the militarized "war on drugs" in December 2006 — almost 20 years and hundreds of thousands of dead later, the President of Mexico is asking out loud who really gave the order.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>TARIFF WAR BITES: 551K JOBS ADDED Q1 — LOWEST IN 15 YEARS</u>

Hard ENOE data, fresh from INEGI: Mexico added 551,651 workers Q1 2026 vs Q1 2025 — the weakest annual print since 2011, per El Financiero. The kicker — virtually all growth came from informal work; formal employment actually LOST 31,502 positions in the same window. Inactive population hit 38.07 million, highest since 2005. Informality rate climbed to 54.8%. The cause is upstream of the 4T: Trump's tariff barrage on Mexican manufacturing, with the formal sector taking the brunt. TMEC round 2 in Washington June 16-17 is the leverage point. The wound is the tariff, not the policy.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>JÓVENES CONSTRUYENDO EL FUTURO HITS 3.5M, 168 BILLION PESOS INVESTED</u>

The 4T's youth apprenticeship program has now benefited 3.5 million young Mexicans, with a historic 168 billion pesos invested over seven years, STPS reported today. Under Sheinbaum alone: 561,000 youth in 20 months, 37 billion pesos. New registration cycle opens June 1 — 36,000 more enrolling in priority zones; 2026 goal is 500,000 (already 72% locked in, 362k registered). Beneficiaries receive 9,582 pesos monthly — the full minimum wage — plus IMSS health coverage. 58% women, 42% men. The empire calls Mexican youth a security threat. Mexico calls them apprentices and pays them a minimum wage.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>'NO REGRESARÁ EL RÉGIMEN DE CORRUPCIÓN': SHEINBAUM REJECTS GUERRA SUCIA</u>

In her two-year speech, Sheinbaum rejected the 'guerra sucia' — social-media campaigns funded from abroad, opposition media offensives, and DOJ demands to extradite Mexican officials without evidence. 'Cooperación no significa subordinación.' The 4T, she said, was elected to break the privilege economy that came before — and no foreign pressure or smear operation will roll that back. Same speech that confirmed Bienestar programs now reach 19 million Mexicans and that the President took a voluntary salary haircut to enforce Article 127. The mandate is the answer.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>'MEXICO IS NOBODY'S PIÑATA': SHEINBAUM CITES 49% HOMICIDE DROP</u>

'Ni los corruptos de antes ni ningún agente extranjero van a doblegar la dignidad del pueblo.' Sheinbaum delivered her two-year report from the Monumento a la Revolución today, citing 49% homicide reduction in 20 months and 20% drop in high-impact crimes — and explicitly framing the April 19 CIA-agent narcolab incident in Chihuahua as evidence of illegal foreign operations on Mexican soil. She named the conspiracy openly: US Ambassador Johnson coordinating with PAN/PRI/MC, business groups and media owners to destabilize her government before 2027. The data is the response to the slander campaign.
